name: General intake - unclassified or non-medical call

steps.goal: Confirm the exact address of the emergency

prompts.text: This is ECHO emergency intake. What is the exact address of the emergency?
I heard {{location_raw}}. Can you confirm that address?
Tell me exactly what is happening.

steps.goal: Select services for the classified category

prompts.text: I have your location and what's happening. I'm connecting you with a dispatcher now; stay on the line.

steps.goal: Hold the prepared dispatch for human approval

prompts.text: Help is being prepared, but I need the exact address. Where are you right now?
Responders are being prepared for {{location_normalized}}, about {{eta_minutes}} minutes away. Stay on the line.
I'm alerting the dispatcher now. Stay on the line.
